subject: 🏃 Tuesday — 3×2 mi Track Threshold (Wk 10 Peak)
html:
Tomorrow you have 3×2 mi threshold reps on the track — the Week 10 peak-week sharpener. 19 days to race day.

HR governs: target 155–165 BPM, cap 165. Pace readout ~7:15–7:25/mi. Three reps, 3-min jog recovery between each. 1.9 mi easy jog to the high school track, reps on the flat oval, 1.9 mi jog home — ~8–9 mi total.

Extended warm-up (hamstring protocol): Do the standard pre-run activation at home (hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges, banded hip IR 5–10/side), plus the posterior-chain block added this week: 2×10 dynamic leg swings per side (forward/back + lateral), 10 walking hamstring reaches per side, 10 glute bridges. Foam-roll posterior chain before you head out.

Recovery context: Sunday's 16-miler was a rough one — heat, underfueled, walk/run from mi 10.7, suffer 261. Your legs may still be carrying some of that even after today's mobility day. If the WU jog feels genuinely flat or the hamstring talks during warm-up, drop to 2 reps rather than grinding through all 3 — peak-week quality over peak-week volume.

Hamstring hard stop: Three faint right-hamstring appearances in 11 days (Jun 24 → Jul 1 → Jul 5). If it sharpens during any rep — not a twinge, a genuine pull sensation — stop the set and jog home. The warm-up is the first line of defense; respect the pattern.

Focus cue: Even effort across all three reps. The 2-mi format rewards patience — don't front-load rep 1 and fade in rep 3. Let HR settle into the 155–165 band by ~800m and hold it there.

Where you are: Week 10 of 12, Phase 3 Peak Volume & Power — the biggest training week of the build (~48 mi). Tuesday's track is the appetizer; Thursday's 10-mi progression and Sunday's 20-mi dress rehearsal are the main courses. Get the threshold stimulus, stay healthy, save the legs for what's ahead. Wear the H10 — you need clean HR data all week. Bed by 10.
